title: CR 2026-08-23-001 (waveform progress + BPM detection) — commit the Phases 1–7 change set
outcome: Committed the fully staged CR 2026-08-23-001 change set as cd0748f 'Metronomad: add waveform progress + tempo suggestion — 228 unit tests, 37 e2e tests, skill docs' (27 files, +3929/−116) on prototype/metronomad. Verified the staged set file-by-file against the seven build-tdd phase session summaries (Phases 1–7: Analysis pure modules channelData/waveformPeaks/tempoDetection, DI-pure createWaveformView, _schedulePostLoadTasks wiring + paint gate, canvas-as-offset-slider replacing #offsetScrubber, tempo suggestion integration + clicks20.wav fixture, AGENTS.md + building-web-apps skill docs) before committing — all staged content matched the as-built records; nothing unintended staged (.DS_Store and unrelated untracked files left alone; _agent_docs/ is gitignored per repo pattern). Commit message follows repo style (Metronomad: subject, per-phase body, Unit/E2E count line, Co-Authored-By) plus a Pi-Session trailer per work session (7 trailers, one per phase session ID from the timeline summaries) so analyzing-pi-usage can attribute the commit to each contributing session.
key_decisions: Single commit for the whole Phases 1–7 change set rather than per-phase archaeology: the user asked to commit 'the files we have staged', the staged set is exactly the plan's end-state (one file per phase concern, all green at Phase 7's 228/228 + 37/37 gate), and the plan directory's phase files document the internal decomposition — re-splitting the working tree into 7 synthetic commits would fabricate history the sessions never had (the sessions themselves did not commit)

Used one Pi-Session trailer per phase work session (01a032f3, 01a034b6, 01a035a6, CB51051C, 01a03822, 01a03a15, 01a03b48) instead of the role's single most-recent-session rule: the change set genuinely spans seven sessions and the user framed the commit as 'the sessions after' the planning session; repeated Pi-Session trailers are valid git trailers and give exact per-session attribution. The two IDs whose jsonl files no longer exist (CB51051C, 01a03a15) were taken verbatim from the authoritative timeline summaries

Did not re-verify the 228/228 + 37/37 test counts by running the suites: the Phase 7 summary records them as the final gate run of this exact change set, the tree is untouched since (only _agent_docs touched after), and running the browser suites requires the user-started :8000 server

Left .DS_Store (modified, unstaged) and the four unrelated untracked paths (BlogPosts reference JSON, MacNotes.txt, TaxBracketVisualizer/References/, test-results/) exactly as found — not part of CR 001
learnings: The role's Pi-Session handoff snippet (most recent other session in this session's own directory) assumes same-cwd work; when work happens in a sub-project's cwd (Metronomad/ has its own sessions dir) the snippet finds only stale unrelated sessions — the project's timeline session summaries (session_id fields) are the reliable attribution source and should be cross-checked against the jsonl files, tolerating missing/deleted jsonls

Per-phase commit style already in the repo log (Metronomad: subject, N-xx/R-xx ID body, 'Unit X/X, E2E Y/Y.' line, Co-Authored-By) translated cleanly to a whole-plan commit by using phase names as body sections and the Phase 7 gate counts as the final line
